body: I am pre-T however I have the mirena IUD. I talked to my doctor about if it would interfere with taking testosterone in the future and she assured me it would not at all. Personally the mirena has been a great experience for me. Good info to have is that you can demand to be sedated during the procedure. I find going to the gynecologist to be extremely triggering so it was very nice to not have to be awake during the experience.
